items.title: Gibson Brass Band: Joseph Bentley, Albert Miller, Ronald Cayette, Eddie Richardson, George Starling, George…
items.q: It was Claiborne Williams and his orchestra. That's right, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. They were born in New Orleans.

Mm-hmm. And do you read music? Mm-hmm. You read music. Can you remember some of the bands that you played with? Or what was the first band you played with? Can you remember? George Williams. You played with George Williams? George Williams. That was a brass band? No, that's a—you remember a Claiborne Williams band? Yeah, Claiborne Williams.
Well, after the old man died, well, his son took the band over. The band is under the name of—the band goes under the name of George Williams and his orchestra now.
